name: discordsimple-connector
description: Connect Claude to your Discord servers through DISCORDsimple, a multi-tenant remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) operated by CCMS Hosting. Post announcements and briefs — new support emails, project-management alerts, scheduled morning briefs — to the channels you choose, as text or rich embeds. @everyone and role pings are disabled, message content is never stored, and your bot credentials live on the CCMS server — never in this plugin and never sent to Anthropic.
